Definition: Pinechas, the name of three Israelites
BiblicalUsage: Phinehas = "mouth of brass"; 1) son of Eleazar and grandson of Aaron; his zealousness for the Lord averted a plague on Israel and gained him the promise of the Lord of an everlasting priesthood in his family; 2) a priest and the son of the priest Eli; 3) the father of a helper of Ezra
